title: What If ICE SANK? 🌀 #Swirlverse
description:
In our world, ice floats - it's about 9% lighter than water. But in this parallel world, ice SINKS... and lakes freeze from the bottom up! 🥶🐟
Floating ice or sinking ice? Comment below 👇

Real science: floating ice insulates lakes so the water below stays near 4°C and fish survive the winter.
